```{r setup, include=FALSE}
install_if_missing <- function(pkg) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
}

packages <- c("knitr", "dplyr", "kableExtra")
lapply(packages, install_if_missing)

library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

set.seed(123)



show_image <- function(path, caption = NULL, width = NULL, height = NULL) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    if (!is.null(caption)) cat(sprintf("%s\n", caption))
    knitr::include_graphics(path, dpi = 300, auto_pdf = FALSE)
  }
}


```


---


# Organoids data integration

\



Integrated data of fused dorsal-ventral organoids:

- 17D17V - healthy
- 21D21V - healthy
- 71D71V - disease
- 77D77V - disease
- 21D71V - mosaic
- 71D21V - mosaic

---

### Quality Control

\

```{r echo=FALSE, out.width = '100%', fig.align="center", results='asis'}
show_image(file.path(getwd(), "gene_hist_organoids.jpeg"), "Genes per cell")

```

\

```{r echo=FALSE, out.width = '100%', fig.align="center", results='asis'}
show_image(file.path(getwd(), "cell_hist_organoids.jpeg"), "Cells per cluster")

```

\

# Disclaimer

The analysis was performed through the non-profit and open-source library **JDtI**.
Remember, *in silico* analysis must be validated *in vitro* or *in vivo*. For more information, visit [GitHub](https://github.com/jkubis96/JDtI) or contact us.
